science_goal: Test if the difference between ridge rock and hollow rock holds across several ridge and hollow pairs in the walk area.

base.label: Crew rover, parked at the Curiosity position of sol 4534

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Break a fresh face on the ridge rock with a hammer. Compare the inside with the weathered surface through a hand lens and bag the chip.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Dig a trench 20 cm deep in the hollow floor. Photograph the wall of the trench and bag material from the top and from the bottom.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Measure the direction and the tilt of the ridge wall at three points with a compass clinometer, and mark each point on the map.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Trace one light vein by hand from the ridge wall into the hollow floor. Sample both ends and record the length walked.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Pick the three nodules that look most different inside a circle of 5 m, by eye. Bag them and photograph each place before removal.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Chip paired samples from the ridge top and from the hollow edge next to it, in the same light, within one stop.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Sample a hollow that the rover did not visit: dig a trench 20 cm deep and bag material from the top and from the bottom.

stations.relief_note: height above (+) or below (-) the mean of a 31 m box, from the 1 m terrain
stations.task: Sample a ridge that the rover did not visit: break a fresh face, compare it with station 1 by eye, and bag the chip.
